_comment: Module registry for the Fable 3 Decomp atlas. Each entry defines one module. 'universe' is where the function list comes from: {'type':'main_cpp','path':...} parses '// name  (0x<start> - 0x<end>)' annotations, or {'type':'json','path':...} reads [{'name','addr','size'}]. 'matched'/'nearmiss' are per-module status lists (relative to this directory).
